task_completion.description: Identify users with 3 or more 1-star reviews in the database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing a query (SQL or visual) counting reviews per user, specifically identifying bot.alpha@spamnet.com and bot.beta@spamnet.com as having 3+ 1-star reviews.

task_completion.description: Update the Profiles class schema to include a STRING property named AccountStatus.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OrientDB 'Schema' or 'Classes' tab showing the 'Profiles' class with a new property 'AccountStatus' of type 'STRING'.

task_completion.description: Create the SuspensionLog vertex class and HasSuspensionLog edge class.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OrientDB 'Schema' tab showing 'SuspensionLog' listed under Classes (Vertex) and 'HasSuspensionLog' listed under Classes (Edge).

task_completion.description: Update the AccountStatus of identified offenders to 'Suspended'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Browse' or 'Query' result showing the Profiles for bot.alpha@spamnet.com and bot.beta@spamnet.com with the AccountStatus column set to 'Suspended'.

task_completion.description: Create SuspensionLog vertices with Reason 'Review Bombing' for each suspended user.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A query result from the 'SuspensionLog' class showing two records with the Reason property set to 'Review Bombing'.

task_completion.description: Link the suspended Profiles to their respective SuspensionLog via HasSuspensionLog edges.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OrientDB Graph editor or a query showing an edge of type 'HasSuspensionLog' connecting the Profile vertex to the SuspensionLog vertex for the bot accounts.

integrity.description: The agent used the OrientDB Studio web interface rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the browser window with the OrientDB Studio UI (Studio, Query, Schema, or Graph tabs).

integrity.description: The agent did not delete the 1-star reviews or the user profiles.
integrity.visual_evidence: The review count for the bot users remains the same in queries before and after the suspension actions.

integrity.description: The agent did not suspend innocent users (those with fewer than 3 1-star reviews).
integrity.visual_evidence: Query results showing 'innocent.user@normal.com' still has a null or active AccountStatus, not 'Suspended'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The database name is 'demodb'. The users to be suspended are 'bot.alpha@spamnet.com' and 'bot.beta@spamnet.com' because they have 3 or more 1-star reviews. 'innocent.user@normal.com' should NOT be suspended. The required schema changes are: Profiles.AccountStatus (STRING), SuspensionLog (Vertex class), and HasSuspensionLog (Edge class). The reason in the log must be exactly 'Review Bombing' and the status must be exactly 'Suspended'.
